decisions.reason: As a low-cost finish extension of the core drainage range, it preserves a design option with little downside while demand for black bathroom fittings is still being tested.
This product fits the firm's design-and-installation positioning and barrier-free bathroom trend, so the option value of staying in the market is high relative to the likely cost of keeping it.
Although more niche and support-intensive than standard gravity drainage, it addresses difficult installation cases, so we would keep it one more year while uncertainty about adoption resolves.
A tileable floor drain is close to the firm's established competencies and customer base, making it a strong strategic fit that is too early to abandon.
This design grate is likely inexpensive to maintain as a catalogue option and supports the firm's aesthetics-led offer, even if overlap with other grates makes it somewhat more disposable.
